result.decision_rationale:
The candidate passes the 140-check baseline gate. Legacy recon recovery is fixed. Two required guarantees remain incomplete: a clean receipt can include authored code absent from its commit, and alternate names for a published ZIP can bypass its receipt or leave that receipt exposed to overwrite.

## Continuation for Claude

Keep the corrections in the existing compiler-input and package-path helpers. Determine source ownership from the resolved compiler path before reducing it to a display name. Compare literal Git pathnames. For package operations, identify the selected ZIP’s physical publication directory and long filename before deriving the lock, receipt and protected report inputs.

Use the existing disposable fixtures to exercise the cases in the findings, then run the configured baseline gate within the remaining validation allowance. The four-loader static audit remains attributable to the matching DLL digest. OWNER AMENDMENT 3 keeps gameplay, live installation and combined-stack testing outside this correction.

executed_verification: Verified HEAD, the mission and amendment hashes, and the full 10,867-line feature diff against Git. The controller gate log’s SHA-256 matches its receipt.
The controller ran scripts/Test-LoaderBaseline.ps1 at the exact candidate. It exited 0 in 597.2 seconds with 140 distinct passing checks and an unchanged worktree.

The cold-cache build at the candidate produced shipping version 0.12.3, ZIP SHA-256 e00a265c573c008bd26368f058dc4095492044540c32932e1437d7cf0a04f868 and DLL SHA-256 7cd3cb09f12f75a7247c1b401673528a0773a139e59dc3a940da860c28f24904. Its standalone current-provenance check passed. The alternate-version clone reported 290 tests passed and zero failed.

The gate recorded the pinned direct MSBuild inputs, rejection of the lowered-manifest legacy DLL, the mixed-case artwork and ordinary ignored-source refusals, the short-directory publication refusal, and both Boolean outcomes for the legacy reinstall journal.

Read-only probes confirmed Git ignores the generated-looking authored-source example. A Windows filesystem probe also confirmed that a real file’s 8.3 name resolves while appending a sibling suffix to that name misses the existing long-name sibling.
inspected: Controller-owned mission, all three owner amendments, prior ledger, developer report, transcript notice, candidate gate receipt and full log.

README.md, docs/UMM-COMPATIBILITY.md, the feature diff, the six-file round-seven correction, the production project, compiler inventory, build and validation scripts, installer callers and disposable fixtures.

Archived build, package, profile and static API records. The audit records 14 types and 39 members resolved on UMM 0.31.1, 0.32.4, owner-installed 0.33.0 and 0.33.4 for the same DLL digest and MVID ccc59117-f992-44ce-9355-540d35f181f0.
limitations: The snapshot is read-only. Build and gate results come from the controller receipt and log. The whole foreground transcript was withheld.
Native gameplay, fresh-process save/reload and combined-stack testing were not run. The four loader rows provide static evidence only.
OWNER AMENDMENT 1 accepts the documented historical pre-enrollment evidence gap after effective-profile verification. R5-F3 retains its accepted optional deferral.
required_gaps: Show that an ignored authored input cannot acquire clean provenance through its filename or repository-root location, and that a genuinely tracked non-ASCII source qualifies.
Show that a file link to an active build-owned ZIP cannot enter receiptless external mode.
Show that the ZIP’s own 8.3 filename selects the publisher’s lock and actual receipt, and that content-only report generation preserves that receipt.
source_inspection_only: The remaining provenance, file-link, short-filename and Git pathname failures follow from the candidate code. The gate did not execute those specific cases.
The four-profile static audit was produced at 3779b0e. Its DLL SHA-256 matches the round-seven shipping build. Its historical ZIP digest belongs to the earlier package.

findings.actual: Get-InputName labels every basename ending in .AssemblyAttributes.cs as generated before checking its directory. The validator skips that label. It also skips a repository-root source included through LocalGamePaths.props because its inventory name contains no slash. In either case, the two compiler passes can agree on local bytes missing from the recorded commit.
findings.blocking_rationale: A package can receive verified-current provenance even though a fresh checkout lacks code compiled into its DLL.
findings.expected: Every repository-authored source selected by Csc must belong to the producing Git tree. The existing exceptions should cover genuine generated inputs.
findings.requested_correction: Check the resolved source location before reducing it to a basename or generated label. Preserve the actual intermediate and generated framework-attribute exceptions, including the ordinary clean-build control.
findings.requested_evidence: In the temporary clone, exercise an ignored Blueprints/obj/LocalOnly.AssemblyAttributes.cs and an ignored repository-root source selected through the existing local props import. Show that clean publication refuses each, the previous pair survives, and qualification returns after removal.
findings.title: Authored compiler inputs can still escape the Git membership check
findings.trigger: Place authored C# in src/KingmakerWakingRune/Blueprints/obj/LocalOnly.AssemblyAttributes.cs. The production wildcard selects it and the existing obj/ ignore rule hides it from Git status.

findings.actual: The directory-identity walk starts at the caller’s parent directory. For a file symbolic link outside artifacts, it classifies the link as external. File.Copy reads the published target, while the receipt lookup uses the link’s name. With no receipt beside the link, the helper can return external-content-inspected for the dirty publication.
findings.blocking_rationale: Begin and Reinstall can admit the same partially published ZIP that the canonical-path check refuses.
findings.expected: A live reference to a build-owned output must observe its publication lock and receipt, or decline installation.
findings.requested_correction: Classify the selected file’s publication target before allowing receiptless external mode. Decline a file link whose target cannot be established safely. Preserve content inspection for an independent external copy.
findings.requested_evidence: In the disposable publication fixture, read the dirty output through a file link in another directory during the placement pause. Verify refusal and retain the passing independent external-copy control.
findings.title: A file link to the published ZIP can still enter receiptless install mode
findings.trigger: Supply a file symbolic link outside artifacts that points to the build-owned ZIP between ZIP and receipt placement.

acceptance_ids: OWNER AMENDMENT 3, Waking publication and receipt handling
findings.actual: Both consumers append suffixes to the caller’s ZIP filename. A short leaf such as KINGMA~1.ZIP selects a different lock and receipt name. The installer can refuse a complete build-owned pair or overlook an external pair’s actual receipt. In content-only validation, the real adjacent receipt is absent from the protected identities and can be overwritten by the report. The gate shortens the directory and retains the long ZIP filename.
findings.blocking_rationale: A valid receipt can be skipped or destroyed solely because the caller used Windows’ alternate name for the same ZIP.
findings.expected: Both spellings select the same publication lock and adjacent receipt. Report generation preserves that receipt even when ReceiptPath is omitted.
findings.requested_correction: Derive sibling paths from the actual long filename in both Validate-Package.ps1 and KwrPackage.ps1. Retain the existing checked-handle report write.
findings.requested_evidence: Use the complete short path of an actual ZIP. Confirm contention on the publisher’s lock, successful qualification of the unlocked clean pair, and refusal to write a content-only report to its long-name receipt. Compare both input hashes afterward.
findings.title: The ZIP’s own short filename hides its receipt from validation
findings.trigger: Pass the full 8.3 filename of a receipt-backed ZIP. For the standalone content-only check, select its real long-name receipt as ReportPath.

acceptance_ids: OWNER AMENDMENT 3, Waking authored compiler inputs
findings.actual: The new HashSet stores the display lines from git ls-files --cached. With default Git quoting, non-ASCII names appear quoted with octal escapes. The compiler inventory contains the literal filename, so the membership comparison rejects a tracked source. The fingerprint reader also treats Git’s displayed path as a filesystem path.
findings.blocking_rationale: A clean production build can fail qualification for a valid tracked source filename.
findings.expected: Git membership compares literal repository paths across the supported Windows build route.
findings.requested_correction: Use lossless Git pathname output or literal membership queries for these comparisons and fingerprint reads.
findings.requested_evidence: Commit a non-ASCII C# filename in the disposable clone under default Git quoting. Show that the real build and current-provenance validator accept it while the ignored-source control still fails.
findings.title: Git’s quoted pathname output can reject a tracked compiler source
findings.trigger: Qualify a clean checkout containing a tracked compiler input such as Blueprints/Café.cs with Git’s default pathname quoting.

prior_finding_assessments.rationale: The gate verifies rejection of the ignored mixed-case PNG and ordinary nested LocalOnly.cs, plus recovery after removal. The membership filter still loses authored inputs whose normalized names resemble generated or external inputs.

Interrupted recovery prefers reconEnabled and then legacy recon. An ordinary reinstall reads recon.flag. With a replacement directory present and its flag absent, the disposable fixtures restored both Boolean values to the flag and journal before reaching launch admission. The folder-absent controls also passed.

The gate confirms lock contention through the short directory name and refusal of a missing receipt after lock release. A file link to that same live output still reaches the external receiptless branch because only the caller’s directory ancestry is inspected.
The reproduction instructions now explicitly attribute 120 checks to round five. R7-F3 covers the separate inaccurate cross-reference added in that sentence.

summary.delivered_behavior: Waking Rune declares UMM 0.31.1 and the packaged DLL references UnityModManager 0.31.1.0, 0Harmony12 1.2.0.1 and 0Harmony 2.3.1.1. The candidate gate confirms the requested artwork and legacy-journal cases. The remaining blockers concern source provenance and package identity.
